english.name: Flemish Medical and Dental Admission Exam
english.fullName: Flemish medical and dental admission exam (toelatingsexamen arts en tandarts), in Dutch

notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools 4x). Each test = the real KIW (10 per science) + a GC block of 4 EMCO and 6 VAARDIG. Training: five subject sets 25601-25605 (Biologie, Fysica, Chemie, Wiskunde, Generieke competenties 40 each), so 5 + 4 = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 70 (35 of 50) is Tigertest's readiness target; the real exam needs half the points per part under +3/-1 marking and then a quota rank.
